subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): dispose per-connection CancellationTokenSource (S2930)
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): dispose per-connection CancellationTokenSource (S2930)

Disconnect() cancelled _cancellationTokenSource and waited for both I/O tasks but
never disposed it. Dispose it once both tasks have stopped (safe ordering, no
ObjectDisposedException race) and null the task references. The per-connection CTS
is recreated in Connect(), so this is safe across reconnects.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Targets fork-specific ProtocolSshDotNet.cs; no SshDotNet protocol exists in our fork, so the fix has nothing to apply to.
